# Demo Data Systems: course outline

Synthetic course material authored for this repository; no real institution or learners.

## Learning objective
Explain primary keys, foreign keys and inner joins using the practice tables.

## Assessment policy
Practice questions are ungraded. For the graded lab, the tutor may give hints and an analogous example but must not provide a complete submission.

## Scope
This pack contains no examination date, official grade record, or extension policy.
